messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up — Acme Health wants a 2-week POC next week. Requirements: hosted API keys for integration team, a billing project with a hard spend cap, and a short Dedicated trial (1 GPU pool) plus VPC peering to test private deployment. They will invoice (no CC). Who owns provisioning & billing approvals?
ben-eng: For the hosted keys we can spin up scoped keys quickly. Dedicated trial needs infra lead + finance sign-off. Rough perf estimate? Roughly 200k tokens/day during peak testing.
nisha-finops: We can attach a spend cap on the billing project and apply promotional credits. Policy: spend caps are enforced at the project-level and block further token consumption when hit. For invoice billing we need customer PO and a signed SOW for >= $2k commits. If they want a $5k cap and $2k free credits, finance ok if sales attach the PO.
sam-platform: Actionable steps from our side:
1) Sales to confirm customer billing contact and PO.
2) Platform creates the billing project and sets spend cap.
3) Platform issues a scoped, short-lived API key for the POC integration.
4) If Dedicated trial requested, file dedicated-request (internal) and attach customer PO + expected qps.
5) VPC peering: schedule network kickoff with customer network team (we need their CIDR and peering admin).

Quick commands (internal):
```
# create project (platform only)
redwood projects create --name acme-poc --owner acme@acme.com --billing_type invoice
# create scoped key (14d ttl)
redwood keys create --project acme-poc --scopes invoke,generate --ttl 14d
```

maria-sales: Customer contact: olivia@acme.com (billing). PO number will be provided by EOD tomorrow. They asked for the spend cap to be set to $5,000 and for $2,000 in free credits applied to the project for the POC window. Also need an invoice address: Acme Health, 22 Clinic Way, Boston MA.
jeff-customer-success: For Dedicated trial — we can offer a single pre-warmed T4 pool for 2 weeks with a reduced trial rate. Need to confirm SLA expectations (we default to best-effort for trials). Also confirm model family (they want a Llama2-derived open model).
sam-platform: Notes on access & security: for the short-lived API key we recommend scoping to the single project and enabling token usage alerts. We can also attach an audit log export for the POC (S3/GCS) for Acme to review. For VPC peering we will provision a private endpoint and restrict egress to customer CIDR. Customer must sign an NDA for network access.

nisha-finops: To apply free credits and an invoice billing workflow I need: PO number, legal billing name, tax ID (if provided), and expected start/end dates. I'll create the billing project once I have those. If they need net-30 invoice terms, we require account review — allow 2 business days.
maria-sales: PO coming tomorrow. Start date earliest Mon. They also asked: can we pre-create API keys for different teams (dev, qa) under the same project?
ben-eng: Yes — create keys per team with appropriate scopes and different TTLs. Recommend dev keys 14d, qa keys 7d. Keep production keys separate.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: #INFRA-5123 "Acme POC billing project + stub Dedicated trial" assigned to @sam-platform, @nisha-finops.
sam-platform: I'll provision the billing project when PO lands. For Dedicated trial I need expected peak tokens and model size (e.g., 7B vs 70B). If 7B family -> T4 pool likely fine. If bigger, need GPU reservation approval (longer lead time).
maria-sales: I'll ask Acme to confirm model (they think 7B). Also confirm they can sign NDA.
jeff-customer-success: I'll prep a short SOW template for a 2-week POC that includes the spend cap and trial pool description. Will ping once ready.
nisha-finops: FYI — promo credits flow: we issue a one-time credit line to the billing project id (example: proj_acme_2026). After credits consumed, spend cap will still block. Credits do not override the cap.
maria-sales: Thanks all — will update once PO & NDA received. Can we target provisioning by Friday?
sam-platform: That's achievable if PO arrives by EOD tomorrow. I'll start the scoped-key generation and tagging so we can flip once billing project exists.
jeff-customer-success: SOW draft shared in this thread (link). :thumbsup:
maria-sales: Great, closing loop — will follow up with olivia and post PO here when received.
